# Technomate IT-Solution and SAVIO

Technomate IT-Solution Private Limited builds SAVIO, AI System Administrator software for business Windows fleets. SAVIO gathers endpoint evidence, searches enterprise knowledge, diagnoses routine IT issues, applies only permitted remediations, and verifies the result. Sensitive actions remain behind code-enforced approval tiers.

Primary audience: organizations with roughly 25–500 Windows endpoints, lean IT teams, and office or remote employees.

## Windows troubleshooting guides

Step-by-step fixes for the most common business Windows tickets, each noting which SAVIO action handles it and at what approval tier.

- Windows Update stuck or failing (reset Windows Update components): https://technomateai.com/blog/reset-windows-update-components/
- Printer not printing (stuck Print Spooler): https://technomateai.com/blog/printer-not-printing-fix-print-spooler/
- Internet not working on one PC (flush DNS, renew IP, Winsock reset): https://technomateai.com/blog/internet-not-working-windows-flush-dns-reset-network/
- Outlook not responding: https://technomateai.com/blog/outlook-not-responding-fix/
- No sound or microphone not working: https://technomateai.com/blog/no-sound-microphone-not-working-windows/
- Windows PC slow or disk full: https://technomateai.com/blog/windows-pc-slow-disk-full-fix/
- Windows patch management checklist: https://technomateai.com/blog/windows-patch-management-checklist/

## Verified product facts

- Focuses on Windows 10 and Windows 11 business endpoints.
- Uses live telemetry and enterprise knowledge before remediation.
- Enforces automatic, approval-required, and admin-only action tiers in code.
- Uses allowlisted commands and records mutations and agent commands.
- Offers a 14-day full-product trial without a credit card.

SAVIO supports IT administrators; it does not claim to replace accountable human IT leadership.
